Understanding the business, identifying opportunities, and designing meaningful solutions.

    • Visa services : Leads, Visa, PR & Case management
    • Coachings Institute : IELTS, TOEFL, GRE, GMAT, SAT, PTE
  • Understood user roles, operational hierarchy, permissions, and business processes.

02Product thinking & opportunity identification
✓

Collaborated with ceo, pm and software developers to evaluate the feasibility of new features and their technical impact.

✓

Aligned proposed mobile experiences with backend capabilities, ensuring APIs could support seamless functionality across platforms.

✓

Prioritized features that could increase operational efficiency for agents and staff.

04Introduced new product features

Based on research and workflow analysis, I proposed and designed several product enhancements:

  • AI-powered document scanner
    • Instantly scan and extract information from student documents to reduce manual data entry.
  • Instant notification center
    • Real-time notifications for application updates, visa status changes, follow-ups, document requests, and task assignments.
  • In-app messaging
    • Enable seamless communication between agents, employees, and branch teams within the CRM.
  • Voice notes
    • Allow users to record and share voice updates instead of typing lengthy notes, making follow-up communication faster.
05Information Architecture Agents Overview (Module Study Abroad)
  • Reorganized information architecture for mobile usability.
  • Simplified navigation and reduced unnecessary steps for frequently performed tasks.
  • Prioritized quick actions, dashboard insights, and role-based workflows.
06Design execution
  • Created user flows and information architecture.
  • Designed low-fidelity wireframes to validate workflows.
  • Developed high-fidelity UI screens using a scalable design system.
  • Collaborated with developers to ensure smooth implementation in React Native.
